description:
Global crypto market snapshot -- total market cap, BTC dominance, total 24h volume and the 24h change. Use it when the user asks about overall market conditions or wants a macro view rather than a per-asset reading.

[Access: pay 0.005 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: get_global_market
